q: Write the result $l = 0.04567\,\text{m} \pm 0.0012\,\text{m}$ in millimetres and correctly rounded.
a: $l = (45.7 \pm 1.2)\,\text{mm}$. The first digit of the uncertainty is $1$, so it keeps two significant figures, $1.2\,\text{mm}$, and the result is rounded to the same decimal place.

q: What is the unit of the slope of a $(t, v)$ graph, and what does the slope tell?
a: The unit is $\tfrac{\text{m/s}}{\text{s}} = \text{m/s}^2$, and the slope is the acceleration of the object: how much the speed changes in a second.
